quote.text: You don't have a lead problem. You have a follow-up problem. Twenty-seven people already raised their hand and you haven't closed one.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No prospect replies overnight and no money flags in the inbox, so this is a pure execution day. The one thing to verify before anything else: the last Facebook Ads pull shows the Lead Gen campaign as PAUSED, not delivering at $35/day. Confirm it's actually live, then spend the rest of the day running personal follow-up against every unbooked GHL lead before buying a single new one.
focus: Last ads pull shows the Lead Gen campaign as PAUSED, not delivering at $35/day. Open Ads Manager and confirm the campaign is actually live before the 8 AM refresh — if it's off, your only paid lead source is dead and the funnel goes dry today.

27+ leads at ~$17 CPL and still zero closed means the bottleneck is follow-up, not lead flow. Run a personal call-and-text pass on every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link, starting with anyone who opted in this week.

Inbox is clear of prospects, so today is an outbound day. Confirm the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 FB groups, then manually DM 10 home-service businesses to build pipeline that doesn't depend on ad spend.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours, and nothing financial that needs action — the only money-related items are routine deposit receipts and a Bank of America fraud-prevention promo (not an alert). Everything else is noise: an Anthropic API rate-limit notice (no action), LinkedIn post/job updates, an Upswing poker newsletter, a Skool event reminder, and a ClearView telehealth forms reminder (personal, not Novaro). No prospect email action needed; today's work is verifying ad delivery, follow-up, and outbound.
